`review_559` regression checkpoint at the fixed current pin `5bffdf2f` (after preserving the historical `d7d78b18` run): the original `unfold thresholdValue; fun_prop` still exhausts its unchanged 200,000-heartbeat budget. No failing positive has been relabelled as a negative.

A bounded diagnostic adds only three computed-operand plain unary add/subtract/multiply rules, proved from existing plain composition/pairing. It makes the original positive and the complete arbitrary-leaf supplied-certificate positive elaborate, but the complete missing-leaf control still times out. The whole diagnostic command therefore fails; this is not a completed regression PR or an accepted negative. The first attempted `Type*` frontend telescope also exposed the existing composition rule’s shared-universe limitation; the successful positive-route diagnostic uses `Type`, matching the current captured binary frontend, and makes no broader universe claim.

The trace identifies inner-first composition exploring a binary intermediate before an outer unary operator constrains it. A suggested local attribute-removal A/B was **not executed**: this pinned Mathlib explicitly rejects `fun_prop` attribute erasure. No composition order/backend/limit/production registration has changed. Existing #1171/#1168/Extraction/PPT controls remain untouched. Work is continuing on the smallest honest proposal; public API additions would require outside review.

[Immutable source/log/command and limitation packet](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/tree/7c2a9fdb5d5de8c745476c8e0f3b0649e788b45f/evidence/1155-regression-559) is published with a portable SHA-256 manifest. This is a failing/prototype evidence branch, not a production PR. All own jobs are terminal and the builder slot has been returned; no source or cache in the measurement worker’s tree was changed.
